what: A submission can be 80-98% non-informative and still pass the submission contract.
reproduce: python3 - <script that buckets attempt_1/attempt_2 against the test inputs>
contract_verdict: Both passed `problems: 0 / VERDICT PASS`. The format validates keys and shapes, not content.
caveat: The reference's 91.9% is a BUDGET artifact (ARC_REFERENCE_COMMIT_BUDGET=1800 against the competition's 12 h); ours is a CAPABILITY artifact (it ran to completion on all 240 tasks in under a second and still produced 98.5% filler). The format cannot tell the two apart.
